{g,kelas} kanthi {n, 50} siswa nduweni macem-macem hobi. {n_1, 10} seneng {h_1, nggawe kue}, {n_2,5} seneng main {h_2,bola basket}, lan sing liyane seneng {h_3,main video game} utawa {h_4,main musik}. {name,Garrett} lagi nggawe popcorn kanggo camilan. Nalika {p,wajan} isine biji jagung wiwit panas, biji jagung wiwit meletus luwih cepet. {n,20} meletus ing {s, 30} detik pisanan nalika masak, banjur {k_2_txt,telu} kaping jumlah kuwi ing {s, 30} detik sabanjure. Biji jagung mundhak dadi {k_3_txt,patang} kaping tingkat meletus pisanan ing {s, 30} detik sabanjure, nanging ing {s, 30} detik pungkasan, meletuse alon dadi setengah saka tingkat {s, 30} detik sadurunge. Sawise {name,Garrett} njupuk {p,wajan} saka geni, seperempat saka jumlah biji jagung sing meletus ing {s, 30} detik pungkasan nalika masak uga meletus saka panas sisa. Pira butiran popcorn sing kudu dipangan {name,Garrett}?


#init:
- name = sample(names)
- p = sample(['wajan', 'panci', 'wajan datar'])
- $n = range(10, 101, 10)
- $s = range(10, 31, 2)
- k_2_txt, k_2_val = range_str(2, 5, 1, numbers)
- k_3_txt, k_3_val = range_str(3, 8, 1, numbers)

#conditions:
- k_3_val > k_2_val
- divides(k_3_val * n, 8)

#answer: n + (k_2_val * n + k_3_val * n) + (k_3_val * n // 2) + (k_3_val * n // 8)

Sawijining petani tuku panganan kanggo {animals,kuda}é. Panjenengan tuku macem-macem {treat1, jadah}, {treat2,jelai}, {treat3,wortel} lan {rare_treat, gula kubus}. Amarga {rare_treat,gula kubus} minangka panganan khusus, panjenengan mung tuku {n4_txt, loro} {w4,1}-{unit,pon} kotak kanggo kabeh kandang. Panjenengan mung arep cukup {treat3,wortel} kanggo mangan {animals,kuda} nalika sayuran isih seger, mula panjenengan tuku {n3_txt, papat} {w3,12}-{unit, pon} kantong. {treat1, jadah} minangka panganan utama {animals,kuda}é, mula panjenengan tuku {n1_txt, patang puluh loro} {w1,75}-{unit,pon} paket. {treat2,jelai} minangka panganan pokok kanggo nambah {treat1, jadah}, mula panjenengan tuku {n2_txt, rong puluh} {w2, 65}-{unit,pon} karung. Yen truk petanié bisa nggawa {total,2250} {unit,pon}s sapisan, pirang-pirang perjalanan sing dibutuhake petani kanggo ngangkut kabeh panganan?

#init:
- animals = sample(['kuda', 'sapi', 'domba', 'babi', 'alpaka'])
- unit = sample(weights_med)
- treat1, treat2 = sample(["jadah", "jagung", "jelai", "apel", "gandum"], 2)
- treat3 = sample(["wortel", "bit", "mentimun"])
- rare_treat = sample(["gula kubus", "kulit semangka", "permen mint"])
- n4_txt, n4_val = range_str(2, 7, 2, numbers)
- n3_txt, n3_val = range_str(4, 11, 2, numbers)
- n2_txt, n2_val = range_str(15, 21, 1, numbers)
- n1_txt, n1_val = range_str(30, 43, 2, numbers)
- $w4 = range(1, 4)
- $w3 = range(8, 13, 2)
- $w2 = range(45, 70, 5)
- $w1 = range(55, 80, 5)
- $total = range(1500, 2300, 150)

#conditions:
- w4*n4_val < w3*n3_val < w2*n2_val < w1 * n1_val
- divides(n1_val*w1 + n2_val*w2 + n3_val*w3 + n4_val*w4, total)

#answer: (n1_val*w1 + n2_val*w2 + n3_val*w3 + n4_val*w4)//total

Kanggo nelpon saka {dev,telepon umum}, sampeyan kudu mbayar {currency,Rp}{frac1,0.25} saben menit telpon. Sawise {t,16} menit, regane mudhun dadi {currency,Rp}{frac2,0.2} saben menit. Pira regane telpon {total,36}-menit?

- is_int(frac1 * t)
- is_int((total-t) * frac2)
